title: SARS-CoV-2 Nsp1 suppresses the canonical NF-kappaB pathway by promoting ubiquitin-dependent degradation of TAK1 kinase.
authors: Wei, Han-Cheng; Yang, Qingxin; Yang, Hong; Wang, Yu-Hang; Wang, Kai; Linghu, Kepan; Ogando, Natacha S; Huang, Xiaoya; Snijder, Eric J; Zhong, Yu; Chen, Yu; Yuan, Quan; Chen, Lu; Lin, Jing-Wen
one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白语言模型预测SARS-CoV-2蛋白对NF-kB通路的扰动，核心是病毒蛋白Nsp1与TAK1激酶的蛋白-蛋白互作及降解，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: Immunoregulatory proteins expressed by SARS-CoV-2 interfere with host antiviral defences in infected cells and play critical roles in the pathogenesis and clinical manifestations of COVID-19. Here, we established a prediction algorithm by integrating a pretrained protein-language model and gene weights in immune-related pathways to quantify perturbations of SARS-CoV-2 proteins in host immunity. The results revealed that the canonical NF-kappaB pathway was dynamically regulated by SARS-CoV-2 infection and that nonstructural protein 1 (Nsp1) significantly suppressed the activation of the NF-kappaB pathway by other viral proteins and proinflammatory cytokines, such as IL-1beta. Nsp1 binds to TAK1 at the TAB1-binding domain, promoting TRIM21-mediated K48-linked ubiquitination and subsequent proteasomal protein degradation, leading to the inactivation of the NF-kappaB signalling pathway. This work presents a novel framework to identify viral immunoregulators at the pathway level and provides mechanistic insights into immune evasion by SARS-CoV-2.
abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2表达的免疫调节蛋白干扰感染细胞中的宿主抗病毒防御，并在COVID-19的发病机制和临床表现中发挥关键作用。在此，我们通过整合预训练蛋白质语言模型和免疫相关通路中的基因权重，建立了一种预测算法，以量化SARS-CoV-2蛋白对宿主免疫的扰动。结果表明，经典NF-kappaB通路受到SARS-CoV-2感染的动态调控，且非结构蛋白1（Nsp1）显著抑制了其他病毒蛋白和促炎细胞因子（如IL-1beta）对NF-kappaB通路的激活。Nsp1在TAB1结合域与TAK1结合，促进TRIM21介导的K48连接泛素化及随后的蛋白酶体蛋白降解，导致NF-kappaB信号通路失活。本研究提出了一种在通路水平识别病毒免疫调节因子的新框架，并为SARS-CoV-2的免疫逃逸机制提供了深入见解。
